question: Should OpenClaw core accept this default-off continuation model now, including model-elected follow-up turns, delegates, and request_compaction, or should the capability be narrowed to a plugin/followup API first?
rationale: The PR is a large new core runtime capability with new config, persistent state, model-controlled scheduling, and opt-in cross-session context routing; code review can find defects, but only maintainers can accept the product and security boundary.

options.title: Accept default-off core continuation after cleanup
options.body: Fix the status-row defect, keep cross-session targeting default-deny, and proceed once the responsible maintainer accepts the linked proof and upgrade risk.

options.title: Narrow to plugin/followup API first
options.body: Defer model-facing continuation tools and land only a smaller generic runtime/API seam if maintainers want less core surface now.

options.title: Pause for exact-head live rerun
